reasoning: Koneru Humpy is a top Indian chess player. The question asks whether her FIDE ranking on 2025-11-02 will be as high or higher than on 2025-10-26 (a 7-day period). FIDE rankings are updated monthly, not weekly. The rankings published on these dates would likely be from the same monthly rating list, unless a new monthly list is published between these dates. Given that FIDE publishes rankings monthly (typically around the 1st of each month), the October 26 and November 2 rankings would likely both reflect the October monthly list, making them identical. Even if a new November list is published by November 2, elite players like Humpy typically have stable or slightly improving ratings over short periods. The probability of maintaining or improving ranking over 7 days is high.
